title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather (ERA5 reanalysis) — NER daily rainfall
source_org: Open-Meteo (ERA5 data from ECMWF / Copernicus C3S)
ml_use: Daily rainfall → per-segment antecedent 1/3/7-day rainfall windows; primary hydro-meteorological disruption trigger.
reliability: High (ERA5 is ECMWF's flagship reanalysis; physically consistent). Used as fallback because imdpune.gov.in is unreachable from this environment.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis (not gauge truth); coarser than IMD's 0.25° gauge-interpolated product for convective extremes; model-based → may underestimate extreme events.
verification_notes: Open-Meteo API verified reachable; ERA5 data confirmed via response.
